title: Audit all nine schema contracts against positive and adversarial outputs

context.use: Read the entire linked section; normative details override this task summary.
Read the entire linked section; normative details override this task summary.

outcome: The published schemas are complete machine contracts rather than permissive success-only validators.

artifacts.purpose: Both report variants and required metrics

interfaces: Independent verifier derives required fields from spec, not by generating schemas only from implementation output.
Each concrete alternative prohibits task-incompatible fields; missing required metric families fail.
Schema dialect and local reference resolution work offline with pinned test tooling.
acceptance_criteria: All input/output operations and status variants validate; systematically deleting required fields or mutating task/status/types is rejected.
Schema tests cover ratios, populations, typed abstention columns, no_data/not_applicable/infinity, observation shapes and source bindings.
No additionalProperties escape hatch admits unsupported extension/plugin data outside allowed opaque fields.

verification.expected: Nine schemas load offline; positive documents and required-field mutation negatives pass.
Every success/error output is a single schema-valid JSON document.
Specific diagnostics; no silent repair or scoring subset.
Invalid run; absence never becomes abstention.
Same calculations and sorted evidence; byte digests can differ.
Valid class accepted; structural defects rejected; no claim of verified reference settlement.
Published schemas validate every result; one JSON document on stdout; stable typed fields, statuses, receipts, and errors.
Respectively alignment error, answered set, explicit unanswered outcome, and probability error.
Rejection with no fallback interpretation. Legally shaped but unreviewed reference sets remain a preparation responsibility.
Scalar and outcome retained; no override to `MATCH`. Distribution is scored only if also submitted as canonical scoring evidence.
Successful hard-label evaluation with unchanged observation values; probability metrics `not_applicable`. Preparation receipt discloses the omission.
Neither scalar replacement nor automatic failure; no scalar consistency equation is part of Validator's scoring contract.
First case is inspection-only; second receives the specified binary metrics. No implicit task conversion.
Typed input/provenance error; no silent omission.
Observation is unavailable without imputation; incomplete scoring family is rejected.
Schema error; no synthesized choice or abstention.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
common_completion_checks: All listed artifacts contain implemented behavior or required evidence; no placeholders.

All tests assigned to this task are listed by Cargo and execute with a nonzero expected test count. Compound conformance/structure cases have explicit later audit test owners in coverage.json; implementers still test each local invariant now.
Relevant fmt/Clippy/test/build checks pass on the pinned toolchain; no bypass, changed tolerance or weakened oracle.
Saved response records exact input/source/output hashes, commands, exit codes, expected/actual results, and unresolved failures.
New or changed-authority artifacts are indexed; operational state is updated in Fizzy after acceptance.
